description: Marks the browser client's ES modules under src/main/resources/static/assets/ as ESM so Node's built-in test runner (node --test) can import them from src/test/js/. No npm dependencies; not served (it lives outside static/). Run the tests with the Gradle :walkie-server:jsTest task, or directly with `node --test 'src/test/js/**/*.test.js'` — pass files or a quoted glob, since this Node treats a bare directory argument as a module to load and fails with Cannot find module.
